title: Uniques
summary: Named, randomly placed monsters that are devastating versions of ordinary monster types. They resemble their kin apart from coloring or armaments, hit harder and resist more, and lead a horde of more dangerous siblings who share the Unique's special magic until it dies. Slaying one yields a magical item.
yields: A magical item from the slain Unique, plus the collapse of the horde's special magic.
standalone_fallback: Run it as a single hunt: the party meets a named, oddly colored brute at the head of an empowered pack in any dark place. They break the pack's borrowed magic by killing the leader, and the leader drops one magical item.

output_dial.level_1: A named monster is spotted with only a thin escort, a manageable fight that dangles a reward.
output_dial.level_2: The Unique leads a horde of noticeably tougher siblings, and the party must work to reach and fell the leader.
output_dial.level_3: The Unique's resistances and its empowered pack overwhelm a straight fight, forcing the party to retreat, split the horde, or find a way to isolate the leader.

yields: Self-knowledge: a clear read on whether the party is ready for the dungeon beyond, and a new plan if not.
standalone_fallback: Run it as a one-shot: a single Unique monster blocks the way forward. How the party fares against it tells them whether to press on, retrain, or change plans entirely.

output_dial.level_4: Stubborn repetition leads to a crushing defeat that forces the party to abandon their plan and rebuild.
